map.TextRank 和云端大模型摘要有何区别？: How Does TextRank Differ from a Cloud Large Model Summary?
map.TextRank 是本地抽取式，只挑原文句子、不动写、零上传、零成本；大模型可生: TextRank is a local extractive method: it only picks sentences from the original without rewriting, with no upload and no cost, while a large model can rewrite more fluently but needs a network and compute and involves sending data out.
map.→ 打开AI 文本摘要工具: -> Open the AI Text Summarisation tool
map.中文文本自动摘要工具，基于 TextRank 算法在浏览器本地抽取关键句生成摘要: A Chinese text auto-summarisation tool that uses the TextRank algorithm to extract key sentences locally in the browser and generate a summary. It runs entirely in the front end and uploads no data, suiting quick reading of long articles.
map.基于 TextRank 算法在浏览器本地对句子构图(相似度连边)，按重要性排序抽: Uses the TextRank algorithm to build a sentence graph locally in the browser (linking sentences by similarity), then extracts key sentences by importance ranking to produce a summary.
map.抽取式摘要保留原文句子，忠于原意但可能缺乏连贯；如需改写式需云端大模型。: Extractive summarisation keeps the original sentences and is faithful to the source but may lack coherence; an abstractive version requires a cloud large model.
map.摘要太短或太长怎么调？: How Do You Tune a Summary That Is Too Short or Too Long?
map.纯前端运行，文本不上传，适合长文速览与隐私场景。: Runs entirely in the front end and the text is not uploaded, which suits quick review of long documents and privacy-sensitive use.
map.调整抽取句数或压缩比；句数过少会漏要点，过多则失去摘要意义，以覆盖主干事件为准。: Adjust the number of extracted sentences or the compression ratio; too few sentences miss the key points and too many defeat the purpose of a summary, so aim to cover the main events.
map.：输入一篇 10 段新闻，工具按句间相似度构图，选出得分最高的 3 句作为摘要。: : given a 10-paragraph news article, the tool builds a graph by inter-sentence similarity and selects the 3 highest-scoring sentences as the summary. If the text contains a key sentence such as 'company revenue grew 30%', it is kept with a high weight.
